text.en:
6th. AUGUST, 2013 No. S60

ACCOUNTANTS ORDER, 2010 (S 115/20 10) Notification of commencement In exercise of the power conferred by section 1(1) of the Accountants Order, 2010, the Minister of Finance, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints 1st November 2012 as the date on which that Order shall commence. Dated this 1st. day of Safar, 1434 Hijriah corresponding to the 15th. day of December, 2012.

DAY ANG HAJAH NING-LELA BINTI DATO PADUKA HAJI MOHAMMAD Permanent Secretary, Ministry of Finance, Brunei Darussalam.
